end.summary: Discussed “Many in the One” through different languages, festivals, and music.
end.parentNote: Riya connected unity in diversity with Hindi and English songs, seasonal harvest festivals, and instruments playing together. They gave examples including Bihu and Lohri, and explained that different instruments can keep their own sounds while making one song. There was a brief mix-up when Riya asked to play a game; they clarified they were okay and wanted a more engaging activity. At home, ask Riya to make a short playlist or drawing showing how different parts can come together while remaining distinct.
